tbesh_html:
1) turned work, well-dressed hair, well-set hair, turner's work
1a) meaning uncertain; possible referring to artistry of the hairdo

strongs_1890.strongs_def: something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses)
strongs_1890.derivation: from H7185 (קָשָׁה) in the sense of knotting up round and hard;
